keyEvents.text: Goal! Trabzonspor 0, Freiburg 1. Lukas Kübler (Freiburg) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Noah Saviolo (Trabzonspor) is shown the yellow card.
